# Ranking Requirements Checklist: GitHub Repository Star Ranking

**Purpose**: Validate that ranking, language grouping, freshness, and static public-site requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before planning.
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are ranking source boundaries defined well enough to distinguish "GitHub repositories" from forks, archived repositories, mirrors, private/unavailable repositories, and deleted repositories? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required repository metadata fields complete for both overall and language rankings, including how missing optional description and language values are represented in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are language ranking requirements complete for language discovery, language availability, and whether every detected language should receive a ranking? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are freshness requirements complete for successful refreshes, failed refreshes, stale data, and first-run/no-snapshot situations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are public read-only scope boundaries complete enough to exclude account, submission, moderation, voting, comments, and administrative workflows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are ranking-size requirements complete for cases where fewer than 1000 entries are available in a total or language ranking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "GitHub repositories by star count" defined with an explicit star-count source, snapshot timing, and whether counts are exact or snapshot values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Ranking Snapshot]
- [x] CHK008 Is the stable tie-breaking rule documented as a requirement rather than only as an assumption? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 Is "primary language" defined clearly enough to avoid ambiguity for repositories with no language, generated-code-heavy repositories, or multi-language repositories? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is "shareable navigation" defined with measurable expectations for direct access, reloadability, and language ranking identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is "clear empty state" defined with enough content requirements for unavailable ranking data, missing language data, and missing metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK012 Is the 36-hour stale threshold consistent with the daily refresh expectation and expressed clearly for visitors across time zones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010]

- [x] CHK018 Can language-specific ranking correctness be objectively measured from the written requirements? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are primary scenarios covered for overall ranking discovery, language-specific discovery, and data freshness awareness? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK023 Are alternate scenarios covered for direct access to a language ranking and fewer-than-target ranking entries? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a first deployment or first refresh where no prior successful ranking snapshot exists? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for repositories that change owner/name between snapshots? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for languages with ambiguous names, aliases, case differences, or special characters? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for star-count volatility between daily snapshots and visitor expectations when GitHub shows different current values? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [x] CHK031 Are accessibility requirements specified for reading rankings, distinguishing ranking state, and moving between overall and language views? [Gap, Non-Functional]
